hehun.title: BaZi Compatibility
hehun.subtitle: Zodiac match · Day pillar · Element support · NaYin cycle (each item explained)
hehun.zodiacHint: The zodiac year turns at Lichun (around February 4), so anyone born before it belongs to the previous animal. If the birthday falls on Lichun itself, use Full BaZi instead.
hehun.note: "Needs work" marks a theme to talk through together; it never means the two of you cannot be together. Compatibility is a reference — the relationship is yours to build.

astrology.title: Western Natal Chart
astrology.subtitle: Tropical zodiac · Planets/Signs/Houses/Ascendant · Swiss-grade (self-hosted XALEN)
astrology.noAspects: No major aspects fall within orb in this chart.
astrology.noDignities: None of the seven classical planets is in domicile, exaltation, detriment or fall.
astrology.traditionalNote: Seven classical planets only, with traditional rulers (Mars rules Scorpio, Saturn Aquarius, Jupiter Pisces). Domicile +5, exaltation +4, detriment −5, fall −4. The Lots of Fortune and Spirit swap formulas between day and night births and use whole-sign houses. Profections start at the rising sign and move one sign per completed year; that sign's ruler is the lord of the year.
astrology.aspectsNote: Orbs: conjunction, square, trine and opposition 6°, sextile 5°; 1.5° wider when the Sun or Moon is involved. Applying = the two bodies are moving toward the exact angle; separating = moving away. Ascendant and MC are not included.

fengshui.title: Feng Shui Flying Stars
fengshui.subtitle: Xuan Kong nine-palace chart · Eight Mansions directions · AI placement tips
fengshui.facingHint: Stand at the main door or main window looking out and read the compass in degrees (0–359)
fengshui.chartLegend: Top-left mountain star · top-right facing star · center period star · bottom annual star (south at top)
fengshui.bazhaiHint: Point the bed headboard, desk and main door toward supportive directions when you can; less supportive sectors suit storage, bathrooms and other short-stay spaces.
fengshui.method: Method: Shen-school Xuan Kong; a facing more than 4.5° off the mountain's center line counts as a leaning facing and uses replacement stars; when only a date is given, the Start of Spring day itself begins the new year.

qimen.title: Qi Men Dun Jia
qimen.subtitle: Hour chart on the rotating plate · chief star and door · AI reading on timing and direction
qimen.method: Method: hour-based Qi Men, rotating plate, Chai Bu cycle rule; Yang Dun from the Winter Solstice and Yin Dun from the Summer Solstice; the center palace lodges in Kun 2; the day changes at 23:00; times are UTC+8 (Taiwan / Beijing).

zeri.title: Date Selection
zeri.subtitle: Almanac do/don't lists · Twelve day officers · Yellow and black path days · Clashes
zeri.method: Method: favourable and unfavourable activities and day deities come from the lunar-javascript almanac data. A good day lists the activity as favourable and is a yellow-path day; a day that lists it as unfavourable or clashes with the resident's zodiac is marked best avoided. Days only, no hour selection.
